subject: Plotting mesh and posterior means and SD into a map.

messages.author: ba15e81cdb632e7c
messages.subject: Plotting mesh and posterior means and SD into a map.
parts:
Hello, I'm completely lost into plotting the results of my posterior means and SD into a map. 
I read several thread where (at my most hardly understanding) LEVELPLOT is the answer to do this but I am completely lost in this.

What I want is to display the location of my mesh into a map (so I can explain geographically where the projection will be) and then plot the posterior mean and sd over the mesh.

I already used inla.projector and inla.project, but I dont understand how to use it on the levelplot function
 
Any help or any link to another good tutorial?
thank you

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Plotting mesh and posterior means and SD into a map.
parts:
A small example can be found at
https://haakonbakka.bitbucket.io/btopic122.html
see the local.plot.field function,
and the other pages there. For a detailed introduction and many examples, see the spde book:
http://www.r-inla.org/spde-book

Best,
Haakon
